text.title: Growth Viral Loops Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the viral-loop spec: an inherent share event as the primary loop (an invite modal or referral page only as a secondary loop with its own K), K decomposed into invites per active user and accept rate per invite with window and sample, cycle time measured from send to first-send timestamps, a churn-free projection reproduced by templates/loop-projection.py, a K target anchored to the measured baseline and a named benchmark, an invitee path of at most three steps with measured conversions and friction experiments that name their step, five joinable loop events keyed on invite_id and inviter user_id, invitee D30 next to organic D30, an incentive (if any) triggered on activation with caps and a self-referral block, and consent and disclosure. Validator at scripts/validate-growth-viral-loops.py enforces it, including the K product, the projection arithmetic and the target ceiling.

required.field: `share_event` (a product event where sharing creates value for the inviter), `kind` inherent, `value_to_inviter`; `secondary_loop` null or an invite_modal / referral_page surface with its own `k` (r-share-moment-is-inherent)

`invites_per_active_user` and `accept_rate_per_invite` each with `value`, `window_days`, `sample_size`; `k` = their product to three decimals; `cycles_measured` at least 2 (r-k-factor-decomposed, r-k-target-anchored-to-baseline)
`days` from the inviter's send event to the invitee's first send, `method` send_to_first_send_timestamps, `sample_size` (r-cycle-time-measured-and-projected)
`starting_users`, `days`, `projected_users` as templates/loop-projection.py computes from k and cycle days, `ignores_churn` true (r-cycle-time-measured-and-projected)

`current_k` equal to `k_factor.k`, `target_k`, `kind` self_sustaining or increment, `benchmark` with `range_low`, `range_high`, `source`; a target above 1.0 only when current K is at least 0.4 (r-k-target-anchored-to-baseline)
1 to 3 steps from first exposure to an activated account, each `name` and measured `conversion` (r-friction-steps-capped)
each names `target_step` (a path step), `current_conversion` (that step's) and `expected_conversion` above it (r-friction-steps-capped)
invite_shown, invite_sent, invite_opened, invite_accepted, invitee_activated, each with `keys` including invite_id and inviter_user_id (r-loop-events-instrumented)

null for an unincentivised loop; otherwise `referrer_reward`, `invitee_reward`, `trigger_milestone` (never signup), `window_days`, `max_rewards_per_referrer_per_12_months`, `self_referral_block` covering device_fingerprint, ip and payment_instrument, `excludes_existing_and_past_users` true (r-reward-on-activation-not-signup)

`recipient_source` entered_by_inviter or consented_contact_import, `casl_express_consent` true, `gdpr_lawful_basis`, `compensation_disclosure` message, landing_page, both, or not_applicable only when `incentive` is null (r-referral-consent-and-disclosure)

forbidden.pattern: `primary_loop.kind` other than inherent, or a `share_event` that is a post-signup invite modal or a /refer page — bolt-on-referral-page
`k_factor.k` with no `invites_per_active_user` and `accept_rate_per_invite` values behind it, or `k` not equal to their product — asserted-k-without-components
`cycle_time.method` other than send_to_first_send_timestamps, `projection.ignores_churn` false, or `projected_users` that loop-projection.py does not reproduce — cycle-time-ignored
`k_target.target_k` above 1.0 with `current_k` below 0.4, `kind` self_sustaining with a target below 1.0, or a benchmark with no `source` — r-k-target-anchored-to-baseline
more than 3 steps in `invitee_path`, or a friction experiment whose `target_step` is not a path step or whose `expected_conversion` is not above `current_conversion` — r-friction-steps-capped
fewer than the five loop events, or an event without invite_id and inviter_user_id keys — unjoinable-loop-events
an incentive with `trigger_milestone` signup or account creation, no `max_rewards_per_referrer_per_12_months`, or a `self_referral_block` missing a signal — reward-on-signup-fraud
`recipient_source` contact import without consent, `casl_express_consent` false, or an incentive with `compensation_disclosure` not_applicable — contact-import-without-consent

list.item: `primary_loop.share_event` is a product action that creates value for the inviter; any invite modal or referral page sits in `secondary_loop` with its own K.
`k_factor.k` = `invites_per_active_user.value` x `accept_rate_per_invite.value` to three decimals, on at least two full cycles; `k_target.current_k` is that number.
`projection.projected_users` is what `templates/loop-projection.py` returns for `starting_users`, k, `cycle_time.days` and `days`, and the projection says it ignores churn.
`invitee_path` has at most three steps; every friction experiment names one of them and moves its conversion up.
All five loop events carry invite_id and inviter_user_id; invitee D30 is reported next to organic D30.
An incentive, if present, triggers on an activation milestone within a window, is capped per referrer, blocks self-referral on device, IP and payment instrument, and is disclosed.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (K product, projection arithmetic per loop-projection.py, target ceiling, experiment steps, five-event coverage, disclosure when incentivised).
